title: Late Arvind Gaikwad School of Nursing
client: Late Arvind Gaikwad School of Nursing
description: Clean, professional website for Late Arvind Gaikwad School of Nursing (LAGS Nursing) in Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar — bringing a trusted GNM program online.
challenge: LAGS Nursing was well-established locally but invisible online. Students from outside Aurangabad couldn't discover or evaluate the program without visiting in person.
solution: Designed and built a credible institutional website with program overview, eligibility criteria, admission process, faculty section, and inquiry contact form. Optimised for mobile-first use by prospective nursing students.
